questions.question_text: Read the provided unseen passage discussing the psychological impacts of digital minimalism. According to the passage, what is the primary cognitive benefit of adopting a digitally minimalist lifestyle?
options: A) Increased ability to multitask efficiently across different digital platforms
B) Restoration of deep attention and prolonged concentration spans
C) Higher social validation from online peer groups
D) Complete isolation from modern technological advancements
questions.answer: B) Restoration of deep attention and prolonged concentration spans

questions.question_text: Which word from paragraph 3 acts as the most accurate antonym for the term 'compulsive' as used in the context of smartphone usage?
questions.answer: A) Intentional

questions.question_text: Based on the author's research, the deliberate reduction of passive social media scrolling directly correlates with a measurable decrease in ________.
options: C) baseline anxiety and mental fatigue
questions.answer: C) baseline anxiety and mental fatigue

questions.question_text: How does digital minimalism systematically improve an individual's capacity for 'deep work' as outlined in the text? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Digital minimalism eliminates constant algorithm-driven interruptions, allowing the brain to sustain focus on cognitively demanding tasks. This uninterrupted state helps individuals process complex information better and produce higher-quality work without experiencing rapid mental depletion.

questions.question_text: State two specific ways prolonged screen fatigue negatively affects physical health according to the medical experts cited in the passage. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Prolonged screen fatigue leads to severe disruptions in circadian rhythms, causing insomnia, and contributes to chronic postural strain, particularly tension in the neck and shoulders.

questions.question_text: Why does the author draw a comparison between modern digital application interfaces and 'slot machines'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The author compares them to slot machines because both utilize intermittent variable rewards. Applications use unpredictable notifications and likes to trigger dopamine releases, deliberately engineering a psychological dependency that keeps users compulsively checking their screens.

sections.section_name: Section B - Writing Skills & Applied Grammar

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given direct dialog into Reported Speech: The tour guide said to the visitors, "Please do not touch the ancient artifacts."
options: A) The tour guide requested the visitors to not touch the ancient artifacts.
B) The tour guide ordered the visitors that they should not touch the ancient artifacts.
C) The tour guide requested the visitors not to touch the ancient artifacts.
D) The tour guide told the visitors to not be touching the ancient artifacts.
questions.answer: C) The tour guide requested the visitors not to touch the ancient artifacts.

questions.question_text: Choose the most appropriate determiner to complete the sentence: The doctor shook his head grimly because there was ______ hope of the patient's recovery after the venom spread.
questions.answer: B) little

questions.question_text: Identify the option that correctly converts the given direct dialog into Reported Speech: The manager asked the employee, "Why were you absent from the crucial meeting yesterday?"
options: A) The manager asked the employee why he had been absent from the crucial meeting the previous day.
B) The manager asked the employee why was he absent from the crucial meeting yesterday.
C) The manager asked the employee that why he had been absent from the crucial meeting the day before.
D) The manager asked the employee why he was being absent from the crucial meeting the previous day.
questions.answer: A) The manager asked the employee why he had been absent from the crucial meeting the previous day.

questions.question_text: Choose the correct form of the verb to ensure Subject-Verb Concord: Neither the principal nor the senior teachers ______ aware of the sudden change in the examination schedule.
questions.answer: B) are

questions.question_text: Select the correct modal auxiliary to fill in the blank expressing a strong obligation: You ______ wear safety goggles at all times while conducting experiments in the chemical laboratory.
questions.answer: C) must

questions.question_text: Select the correct determiner to complete the sentence: During the devastating floods, ______ volunteers stepped forward to help distribute rations to the stranded families.
questions.answer: C) many

questions.question_text: Choose the correct form of the verb to complete the sentence accurately: By the time the rescue team arrived at the site, the abandoned building ______ completely.
questions.answer: C) had collapsed

questions.question_text: Choose the correct verb to maintain Concord: A large number of local residents ______ gathered outside the municipal office to protest the frequent power cuts.
questions.answer: B) have

questions.question_text: Write a formal letter of complaint to the Store Manager of M/s Electronics Hub, City Center, regarding a newly purchased fully-automatic washing machine that started malfunctioning within a week of purchase. Seek a repair or replacement. [100-120 words]
questions.answer:
12, MG Road, City.
March 15, 2026.
The Manager, M/s Electronics Hub, City Center.
Subject: Complaint regarding a defective washing machine.
Sir,
I purchased a 'Nova Wash' automatic washing machine from your showroom on March 5, 2026, vide invoice number 4598. Unfortunately, the appliance started malfunctioning within a week of purchase. The spin cycle makes an unbearable vibrating noise, and the water drainage system gets frequently clogged, causing soapy water to spill over the floor. Since the product is well within its two-year warranty period, I request you to either send a qualified technician to repair the defect immediately or replace the machine with a new functioning unit at the earliest. I have enclosed a copy of the purchase receipt for your reference.
Yours faithfully,
Rohan.

questions.question_text: Based on the provided pie chart showing the distribution of household waste in a metropolitan city (Organic 40%, Plastic 30%, Paper 15%, Glass/Metal 15%), write an analytical paragraph summarizing the data. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: The given pie chart illustrates the composition of household waste generated in a metropolitan city. The data reveals that organic waste constitutes the largest segment at 40%, indicating a high consumption of biodegradable materials like food scraps and vegetables. Plastic waste follows as a major concern, accounting for a significant 30% of the total garbage, which poses severe environmental threats due to its non-biodegradable nature. Meanwhile, paper waste and glass or metal recyclables both hold equal shares of 15% each. Overall, while a substantial 55% of the waste is potentially recyclable or compostable (organic and paper), the alarming 30% volume of plastic highlights an urgent need for stricter waste segregation and plastic reduction policies in urban households to ensure environmental sustainability.

questions.question_text: Read the extract from 'The Sermon at Benares'. When Kisa Gotami went from house to house asking for mustard seeds to cure her dead son, what specific condition did the Buddha place on the seeds?
options: A) They must be procured from a wealthy merchant's house
B) They must be blessed by a holy monk before sunset
C) They must come from a house where no one had ever lost a child, husband, parent, or friend to death
D) They must be paid for using only gold coins
questions.answer: C) They must come from a house where no one had ever lost a child, husband, parent, or friend to death

questions.question_text: Based on the chapter 'Bholi', what was the primary reason Bholi's parents agreed to Bishamber's marriage proposal despite his age and limp?
options: A) He was a highly educated school teacher
B) He demanded a very small dowry
C) He was wealthy, had a big shop, a house of his own, and did not know about Bholi's pockmarks
D) The Tehsildar had ordered them to arrange the marriage quickly
questions.answer: C) He was wealthy, had a big shop, a house of his own, and did not know about Bholi's pockmarks

questions.question_text: In 'The Making of a Scientist', how did Richard Ebright's mother actively encourage his early interest in learning and scientific discovery? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Ebright's mother actively nurtured his curiosity by taking him on trips, buying him telescopes, microscopes, cameras, and mounting materials. Crucially, she gifted him the book 'The Travels of Monarch X', which opened the world of science to him.

questions.question_text: Why was Matilda Loisel perpetually unhappy with her life in the story 'The Necklace'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Matilda was perpetually unhappy because she was born into a family of clerks but felt she was destined for all the delicacies and luxuries of life. She deeply resented her modest apartment, shabby walls, and lack of fine clothing and jewels.

questions.question_text: In the play 'The Proposal', what makes Chubukov entirely misunderstand Lomov's purpose of visit initially? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: When Lomov arrives dressed in formal evening wear and mentions he has come to trouble Chubukov with a 'request', Chubukov assumes Lomov has come to borrow money. He silently resolves not to lend him any before Lomov clarifies he wants to propose to Natalya.

questions.question_text: How does the bus conductor treat Valli during her journey in 'Madam Rides the Bus'? [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The conductor treats Valli with good-natured amusement and playful sarcasm. Noticing her fierce independence and refusal of help, he jokingly addresses her as 'Madam', respectfully playing along with her mature, self-assured demeanor throughout the journey.

questions.question_text: Compare and contrast the characters of Bholi and Matilda Loisel. How do their attitudes towards their respective flaws and realities shape their ultimate destinies? [100-120 words]
questions.answer: Bholi and Matilda Loisel represent contrasting attitudes toward personal limitations. Matilda, blessed with physical beauty but born into a modest family, is consumed by vanity and discontent. She rejects her reality, borrows a necklace to appear wealthy, and ultimately ruins her life to pay off the subsequent debt, showcasing how superficial desires lead to tragedy. In contrast, Bholi suffers from physical flaws—pockmarks and a stammer—and is heavily neglected. However, instead of despairing, she embraces education. Through her teacher's encouragement, Bholi develops immense self-confidence, eventually rejecting a greedy groom. While Matilda's inability to accept her reality destroys her youth, Bholi's acceptance and courage transform her into a strong, independent woman, proving that character outshines physical beauty.

questions.question_text: "The Buddha's teachings in 'The Sermon at Benares' emphasize the universality of death and the futility of grieving." Elaborate on this statement with reference to Kisa Gotami's transformative experience. [100-120 words]
questions.answer: In 'The Sermon at Benares', the Buddha imparts the profound truth that death is an inevitable, universal phenomenon that spares no one. Kisa Gotami, blinded by the grief of losing her only son, desperately seeks a cure to bring him back to life. The Buddha tasks her with finding mustard seeds from a house untouched by death. As she goes from door to door, she realizes that every household has suffered loss, and her sorrow is not unique. This realization shatters her selfish grief. The Buddha teaches that weeping and grieving only multiply pain and ruin health, rather than bringing peace. Kisa Gotami ultimately learns that surrendering to the cycle of life and death is the only path to true spiritual peace.
